worldcombat.skill.doodle.summary: Captures the target's essence and changes the user's and its allies' Abilities to match.
worldcombat.skill.doodle.use.0: Copy one strong Ability onto the whole team
worldcombat.skill.doodle.use.1: Unify the team's Abilities before a fight
worldcombat.skill.doodle.use.2: Build the team around a target with a key Ability
worldcombat.skill.doodle.description.0: Sketches the target's essence within %1$s blocks; %2$s s wind-up.
worldcombat.skill.doodle.description.1: The sketch spreads into a canvas of about %1$s blocks, stamping up to %2$s allies; the borrowed Ability lasts %3$s s, then all return together.
worldcombat.skill.doodle.timing: Range %1$s blocks, %2$s s wind-up, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.doodle.growth.0: At level %1$s the cooldown from commit drops to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.doodle.growth.1: At level %1$s the cooldown drops again to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.doodle.preference.canv: Radius covered by one Doodle: larger reaches allies farther away but every ally waits longer for the next cast; smaller covers only nearby allies and casts more often. Radius trades against cast frequency.
worldcombat.skill.doodle.preference.ai.m: The move is considered only when the threat is within this distance; larger means sketching from farther away, smaller means only at close range.
worldcombat.skill.doodle.preference.ai.l: On: a holding companion will leave its post to sketch the target. Off: it casts only where it already stands.
